purpose: Python development with uv, pip, venv, native compilation and PostgreSQL clients.
limitations: Install project dependencies from uv.lock, requirements files, or the project manifest.
Compatibility with a particular project must include its dependencies, not only requires-python.

changes: Add opt-in trust for a mounted proxy CA before dropping privileges; preserve workspace ownership.
3.14-trixie.migration: Compatible additive update. Mount one PEM certificate read-only and set LIBRARY_CA_FILE to its container path when needed. Root-owned workspaces can use PUID=0 and PGID=0 without bypassing the entrypoint.
